scope: Owned explicit internal reconnect job after acknowledged transfer and checked original close. Private-file/MockBackend only. No public probe/Apply/clear RPC, native GUI, real device, production daemon or host D-Bus execution.
implementation: FirmwareOwner::close_for_reconnect produces a non-Clone owner only after checked original root teardown. It binds the original backend/admission/target/operation; journal loading cannot reconstruct this capability.

Internal begin_firmware_reconnect requires terminal transfer AwaitingReconnect and retained original-close owner; one job per process. Runtime/shutdown/duplicate/pre-transfer checks precede consumption.

One owned blocking worker observes actual absence then unique same-serial target and fresh identity through existing strict probe. Window30s/poll200ms/cancel checks20ms between calls. New path alone is not absence. First probe error ends job without retry.

Retained status/completion and explicit cancel survive observer/waiter loss. Main shutdown path cancels both jobs and joins the actual reconnect blocking worker; synchronous backend calls cannot be forcibly interrupted.

FreshIdentityObserved is a read-only historical summary, not flash success or resolution authority. Original transfer AwaitingReconnect report, saved intent, journal/settings quarantine remain unchanged. Late cancel/deadline suppresses fresh evidence.

checks.native_gui: not run; no frontend/native app source change

new_normal_coverage: Actual manager handoff/quiesce/close with a synthetic acknowledged activation journal, then observed detach and changed-path fresh query. Observer loss/reattach still completes; original roots closed first, exactly one fresh cmd134, no replay and raw journal/settings unchanged.
Changed path without observed absence times out using the same loop with80ms fixture window, no fresh open and no evidence.
Foreign admission scope and externally replaced but mutually consistent journal/guard operation ID cannot reuse the original-close owner.

Blocked fresh-handle cmd134 write: dropped pending shutdown waiter does not detach I/O; repeated shutdown remains pending until gate releases. Final Cancelled without evidence, handle closed and quarantine unchanged.
Injected probe writer panic: worker actually joins/unwinds handle, retained Failed/unconfirmed diagnostic, raw journal/settings unchanged.
limits: No product live-status/probe/Apply/recovery UI EN/RU or public probe/clear RPC.
No durable reconnect evidence, qualified guard/journal resolution/restoration or permission to retry flash.
Restart cannot reconstruct the original-close capability or infer an already missed reset. Serial-less and missed-fast-reset recovery policy remain.
Observation deadline is not a hard bound on synchronous backend open/write; forced I/O interruption is unavailable.
Extended power/cleanup/transport/resource fault matrix and actual hardware/image/revision/cooling qualification remain.
